Training compute notes:
From tech report: "Mistral Large 4 was pretrained on 3,840 NVIDIA GB200 GPUs in a Mistral data center near Paris.
Our internal training stack is built on PyTorch and CUDA. Pretraining took 45 days, or about 4.15 million GPU-hours, with a model FLOPs utilization (MFU) of 36% and a goodput of 94.1%. Webmeasure MFU against peak hardware BF16 FLOP/s, include matrix-multiplication and attention
FLOPs."

GB200 is 2500 TFLOP/s BF16 peak, so 36% MFU and 94.1% goodput is 32.9% overall utilization. 
3840 * 45 * 24*3600 * 0.329 * 2500 trillion = 1.23e25 FLOP pretraining.

This suggests roughly 40T training tokens, using 6ND: 1.23e25 = 6* 52 billion * D.

For post-training, RL involved 162.5 billion output tokens during rollouts for RL, so RL FLOP was <1% of pre-training. SFT and mid-training tokens were not disclosed.

MFU is reported against bf16 spec, but report mentions FP8 in the pretraining without clarifying the primary format.
